pipeline.name: PREFLIGHT_CANONICAL
pipeline.action: Read REINCARNATION-CONTRACT.md, LFG, BACKBURNER before any routing
pipeline.guard: If backburner has OPEN/BLOCKED, surface it. Do not start new thread.

pipeline.name: SOUL_AUDIT
pipeline.action: Write session prompts to session-{run}-prompts.jsonl immediately
pipeline.guard: One JSON line per prompt. Exact char count.

pipeline.name: SOUL_RECEIPTS
pipeline.action: Write receipts with exact chronological order and char count

pipeline.name: PA_PREFILIGHT
pipeline.action: Before any dispatch, check PA health/status endpoint
pipeline.guard: If quota exceeded or endpoint unreachable, skip PA entirely and go local. Do not retry identical dispatch.

pipeline.name: LOCAL_FIRST
pipeline.guard: PA only after local script confirmed unavailable or explicit user request.

pipeline.name: PHETRAIL_LAYER2
pipeline.action: Write pattern analysis with failure modes + fixes
pipeline.guard: Every failure mode must have a named fix.

pipeline.name: PHETRAIL_LAYER3
pipeline.action: Write prescription pipeline for future runs

fallback.action: Immediately drop to local script. Do not retry PA. Surface quota state as P2 drift finding. Surface to backburner as BB-NEW if systemic.
